geometry_source_policy: Reuse this separate saw mechanism as linked subassembly. DO NOT import rejected R28-R38 geometry, fuse all machinery into one hull or build from reference-billboards.
axes: Godot GLB: +X right, +Y up, +Z forward toward operator/front-facing saw. In Blender source Z is up and -Y points toward the reference camera.

seam_interfaces.fit_rule: Carve a full genuine aperture behind the silver frame, rather than cover the blade with a flat blue panel. Allow real depth for rear chamber and bearing; maintain visible black recess and unobstructed toothed wheel.
The heavy blue body rests on reinforced horizontal timber beams with metal corner brackets; no floating body or saw.
Raw beef remains on viewer-left of blue machine in original front three-quarter image; independent carved crate and individual meat volumes.
Prepared portions remain on opposite side, attached by a real supported metal trough and timber beam; no unsupported gap.
Side cylinder, rod, and crank must follow owner side view and remain physically separate from saw mechanism.
Rear image must show five slots, bolts, blue rear casing and lower supports; not blank/default material.
Layered roof snow sits on physically modeled top wood rim, with folds and overhangs; chimney pierces roof and smoke begins at opening.

calibration_policy: Reference views are not a metric photogrammetry set; determine overall camera/proportions iteratively from all three images. No numerical global saw placement is invented until actual surrounding blue enclosure and reference-registered cameras exist.
iterative_fit_test: Start cooker master with timber chassis and blue enclosure outer shell, dimensioned across source front, side and rear, with empty source camera registration.
Link saw as independent collection via SAW_CASSETTE_MOUNT; adjust only mount parent translation and rotation, keep blade mesh dimensions/proportions intact.
Construct actual cut-out/opening and structural back wall; inspect saw face, moving clearance and blue housing intersections with wireframe plus solid.
Render source three-quarter, right and rear plus two off-reference orbit views. Judge relative scale, frame flushness, handle clearance, part continuity and shadows.
Build raw/finished trays, steel clamps, snow roof and chimney to same world root and shared materials/light rig; no per-part isolated fake scale.
Only after master artistic approval, create LODs with mobile performance and FPS/quality variants, integrate sockets into actual Godot cooker_processor station and run hardware gate.
